signature_moves: The name is the glyph: 'Pie-oneer' -> a camera aperture / pie of blades that doubles as the radial/pie-menu wedges of an app-launcher — motif and product concept fused in one decision
Committed full monochrome (black + silver, zero hue) as a mechanical, tool-like identity stance against a 12-hue platform palette
Chrome-on-obsidian material story: glossy black pillow + machined silver metal reads as a precision instrument (lens barrel / dial)
defects: Off-era icon — glossy skeuomorphic 3D on a macOS 27 / Liquid Glass platform whose current icon grammar is flat layered glass (Icon Composer, 1024 flat canvas); reads dated, likely deliberate house style
Cover pillow-inflation — hero render bulges the squircle into a 3D pillow with wrap-around gloss, breaking Apple's flat front-facing icon convention (marketing artifact; shipping webp is flatter)

Motif information-scent mismatch (Jakob's Law) — a camera aperture trains the 'photo/camera app' schema, not 'app switcher/launcher'; rewards the informed, costs the cold-open user a beat of recognition

aesthetic.direction: obsidian-chrome skeuomorph — a glossy dark machined-metal icon idiom, off-distribution vs the platform's flat Big Sur / Liquid Glass icon direction; closest range-map neighbours are Retro-futurist/Y2K chrome and Industrial/utilitarian mechanical
aesthetic.cluster_hint: obsidian-chrome-skeuomorph (icon cluster, not a UI cluster)

psychology: Von Restorff / figure-ground — single high-contrast silver glyph on black yields a strong, memorable focal that should survive the Dock/Spotlight squint test
Aesthetic-usability effect — glossy machined-metal polish buys a first-impression quality halo before any UI is seen
Jakob's Law (violated) — aperture motif borrows the camera schema, mismatching the app's actual job (launch/switch/control apps); information scent misdirects at first glance
